table.name: TLGNC_WAGON_REP_ATT
table.description: Table containing repair attachments for a wagon. The attachments are ment to be attached to the repair order, technically copied over to TLGNC_ORDER_REP_ATT (ATTACHMENT_TYPE = email (4) when the repair order is created. The attachments belonging to the wagon are going to be deleted when a repair order (tlgnc_order.DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD = REP) is set to delivered.

column.name: ATTACHMENT_NAME
column.description: Human readable name/description of the document. Never used as a reference and therefore changeable.

column.name: ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_rail_repair_attachement_type_bs. The type of the attchment. 1) offer 2) doku 3) invoice 4) email.

column.name: DATA
column.description: The binary data of the document

column.name: DATA_MIME_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_mime_type_bs. The MIME type of the document, 4=application/pdf, 5=application/postscript...

column.name: WAGON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_wagon. The wagon to which the attachment belongs to.
